notes.title: LINUX SUPPORT ADDED
notes.content:
Small announcement update:

I have been compiling for Linux pretty much the entire time the game's been in development, but I'm a bit of a noob when it comes to Linux so I kept it switched off at the fear of promising something i couldnt deliver.

However, thanks to our AWESOME community, I've gotten feedback and troubleshooted away all my issues and after extensive testing, including on the Steamdeck (of which I don't actually own), I've decided to flick the switch on official Linux support on STEAM!

Thanks again to everyone that's helped out and checked out the Early Access builds!!

I still imagine there will be niche issues to patch up, and if you experience anything, make sure to jump onto the discord and let me know!

notes.title: DJ SIMULATOR has been RELEASED!!
notes.content:
DJ SIMULATOR is now available!
Hi everyone! I am a solo developer from Australia and It's been a crazy last year! I quit my job in 2023 to follow my creative dreams. I am a musician, a DJ and a programmer so this project had a lot of momentum from the very beginning and I think it's in a good enough state to take live now!

Updates over the next month will mainly include more music & bug fixes. Shortly afterwards, a roadmap will be drafted up for versions 0.7 -> 1.0. There are a TONNE of things I want to add to the game, but I'm going to need your help to work out what ideas are cringe lol, [url=https://discord.gg/VRN8TzGDUn]Join the Discord to help with development![/url]
